name: Forest
author: Native Tribes
notes: kind=palette: a COLOUR PRESET. Recolours only -- it never touches the shape language, so it cannot undo a skin or the player's UI Shape.
A MATCHED palette: chassis, primary and accent chosen together.
The old preset buttons rotated one accent hue and left the chassis near-black, so the
accent and the body never agreed -- that is the regression this replaces.
Shapes are deliberately untouched, so a preset recolours without changing the UI Shape.
